description: This Java source file defines a custom Button subclass 'LivePointerIconButton' that overrides the onResolvePointerIcon method to dynamically generate a custom PointerIcon with a visual indicator (a circle with an inner offset circle). It is part of the Android API demos, specifically demonstrating custom pointer icons when interacting with touch/mouse input.

classes.name: LivePointerIconButton
classes.description: A custom Button that creates a dynamic pointer icon with a circle and offset indicator based on touch/mouse position.

methods.name: onResolvePointerIcon
methods.description: Overrides the method to generate a custom PointerIcon with dynamic visual elements based on the current touch event and view size.
